runtime.precondition: Captured immediately after build with backend source changes frozen; source hash represents backend runtime sources, not evaluation outcomes.

compactComparison.rule: Same evidence IDs/order/text/coordinates, Recall/MRR, question, source snapshot, model, dataset and retrieval options; citationStyle changes. Provider score drift is disclosed, not hidden. Single paired runs do not prove causality or semantic answer correctness.

confirmation.note: Selected 16-case run reused, remaining 88 cases run once; all failures retained.

finalConfiguration.defaultDecision: Keep universal legacy defaults; experimental pipeline remains explicit opt-in because this is a small self-authored corpus and reranker requires optional credentials.
finalConfiguration.rule: Full dev evidence only; test not yet read. Experimental candidate evaluated even if defaults retained.
